translations.web: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
translations.bsb: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.
translations.kjv: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
translations.asv: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.
